summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of NeuroDevelopment Foundation site. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases passing (read endpoints, seeded content, validation errors, pledge slug flow). Frontend: 16/16 UI checks passing across home, /volunteer and /crowdfunding (theme persist, publications filter/search, grant/CSR/symposium/contact/volunteer/pledge submissions, gallery next/prev/thumb + no autoplay, quick amount buttons, raised amount updates immediately, mobile menu opens with no horizontal overflow at 390px).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking, purely a deprecation warning).

Seeding logic re-seeds whenever collection count differs from seed length; adding new campaigns will wipe existing pledge totals. Consider a versioned/idempotent seed key or upsert by slug so raised_inr is preserved across restarts.
notify_admin awaits email inside the request handler — a slow Resend proxy could add latency to submissions even though failures are logged. Consider BackgroundTasks for fire-and-forget.
seed_data_creation: No manual seeding required; server auto-seeds publications/events/gallery/resources/team/campaigns on startup. Test submissions were TEST_ prefixed where meaningful but not deleted (submissions collection retains them; not user-visible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 23 backend pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py pass against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend Playwright coverage exercised the full happy path on all three routes. Note: pledges permanently mutate the campaigns collection (raised_inr grew by 5000 during test); if you need deterministic percent assertions, take a baseline snapshot first (as tests do). Mobile menu toggle exists; nav links visible after click.
